title: Sorting Table and Cubbies Room
description: One static postal sorting preparation room, one scene and zero new independent models. A complete six-cell sorting cabinet stands at the rear, facing a separate complete open worktable. One unchanged open-front notched letter tray and one whole divided open mail satchel rest side by side on the actual finite tabletop, with a clear gap between them. The table retains its complete open knee space and bracing. A closed scene-only floor leaves a front approach and two side passages. Four whole original models preserve raw GLB mesh and normal payloads, internal node transforms, all triangles and per-face PBR at original unit scale. This is a table-to-rear-cubby preparation layout, not the older street letterbox and parcel-filled cabinet corner with relabelled goods. No letters, parcels, sorting mechanism, delivery process, working weighing equipment, load capacity, reach or accessibility compliance, operational or installation safety is claimed.
